_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

eligibility_engine.notes: FD-backed secured card: the credit limit is 90% of the fixed deposit (KFS). The minimum deposit is not stated in the SBM documents read.

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% processing fee on rental payments (MCC 6513), over and above any merchant convenience fee (MITC Table 07; page FAQ 8)
1% processing fee on education payments (MCCs 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249, 8299), over and above any merchant convenience fee (MITC Table 07; page FAQ 8)

components: 5% of the outstanding amount for POS/ECOM
10% of the outstanding amount for cash transactions
100% of the outstanding amount for interest and fees

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Joining and annual fees are nil and no waiver applies (KFS; MITC Table 01). Card replacement ₹249; cancellation ₹499 + GST in the first year of activation; FD closure fee 1%.

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: SBM Magnet Secured Credit Card KFS (PDF created 9 Jun 2026, SBM file dated 9 Jun 2026; the page links no newer one)

SBM Secured Credit Card MITC and Cardholder Member Agreement, 52 pages (SBM file dated 29 Oct 2026): Tables 01-11 give fees, interest, late fee, forex, surcharge, rent and education fees, cash limits and minimum due for every variant
SBM secured credit card page (read 7 Nov 2026): lists the card with its KFS, MITC and reward links; card image https://www.sbm.bank.in/images/cards/SBM-Magnet-Gild-Card.webp shows the network

open_questions: HELD, no published reward rate: the SBM page says the card earns "unlimited magnet coins as rewards" and links only a KFS and an MITC. No rate, cap, exclusion list or coin value is published by SBM.

Naming: the card image on the SBM page for Magnet is labelled "Gild" (Visa Platinum, file SBM-Magnet-Gild-Card.webp), and a partner-hosted copy of the KFS is titled "SBM MAGNET GILD". The KFS and MITC call the product "SBM Magnet". A person should confirm Magnet and Gild are one live product.
Network: Visa Platinum is read from that card image only; no SBM document names the network. A third-party aggregator lists a Magnet RuPay variant; no SBM document confirms it.
The KFS says payments are made through the "Rupicard Mobile app", which looks like stale wording; the MITC lists the partner as Vistas Technolabs (ZET).
Fuel surcharge: the KFS says "Surcharge Fee 1%"; MITC clause 8.7 ties it to fuel. No waiver is stated.
notes: Interest on POS/ECOM 2.5% a month (30% a year); cash 3.3% a month (40% a year). Cash limit 50% of the credit limit; ATM fee 2.5% or ₹300, whichever is higher.
Page text: "earn FD interest up to 7% p.a." on the deposit.
Rent and education fees of 1% took effect on 15 Jul 2026 (MITC note to Table 07).

value.rule: flat ₹299 + GST on non-payment of the minimum amount due
value.source: Magnet KFS (9 Jun 2026) and MITC Table 08
